title: fix(app-shell): the Studio canvas selection strip names a selected dashboard widget in the session's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GNMYnbm5cgRkMqUGpXobrR)_
Fixes #36480
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 中文会话里在 Studio 仪表盘画布上选中一个卡片，画布上方那行字以前写「已选中：Pipeline by Stage」，现在写「已选中：阶段管道分布」，和右侧属性面板的标题一致。
- 属于「Studio 面板说业务话、跟随当前语言」这一组修复，补上上一轮面板改造没覆盖到的画布状态行。
- 出错时最多是那行字显示回英文原文或卡片编号，不影响保存和数据；直接撤回本次合并即可。
- 无。

## What changes

`StudioDesignSurface` names a selected dashboard widget in the canvas status strip by the text the widget panel's Title box shows, instead of `selection.label` (the authored title `DashboardPreview` puts there). The text comes from the panel's own reading: `shownLabel` over the served widget titles the Interfaces pillar already pairs with the published layer (`servedWidgets`), in the language `useLabelLanguage` names. A new helper, `shownWidgetTitle` in `servedDashboardText.ts`, finds the widget in the draft by id (as `DashboardWidgetInspector` does) and returns that text. No second reading: if the draft holds no widget of that id or its title reads empty, the strip falls back to `selection.label || selection.id`, as before.

The card asks for a check of the other kinds the canvas can select:

- **Report:** `ReportPreview` emits no selection, so the strip has nothing to name on a report leaf. Nothing to change.
- **Page block:** `PageBlockCanvas` / `PagePreview` select `{ kind: 'block', label }` with the block's authored `label`/`title` (else id or type). `PageBlockInspector` uses the same `selection.label` as its title, so the strip and the panel already show the same text. The Studio has no served page text to pair with, so it is unchanged (see Acceptance notes).
- **Navigation entry:** already reads `navInspectorHead.title`, the panel's own title.

Read first (by risk):
1. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the `selectionLabel` expression above `canvasHint`: the only behaviour change.
2. `servedDashboardText.ts` `shownWidgetTitle`: the widget lookup and the `shownLabel` call.
3. The new test's stub canvas, which emits a selection the way `DashboardPreview.handleWidgetClick` does.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.canvasStripServedLabel-36480.test.tsx`. Expect 4 passed. Live: in a zh-CN session, open HotCRM `sales_dashboard` in Studio Interfaces and click 阶段管道分布. The line above the canvas reads 「已选中：阶段管道分布 · Esc 取消选中」.

## Tests

New `StudioDesignSurface.canvasStripServedLabel-36480.test.tsx` (4 cases). It uses the real `StudioDesignSurface` with its right slot and the real `DashboardWidgetInspector`, over the authored English layer and a zh-CN served dashboard in the metadata store:

- zh: the strip names the widget 阶段管道分布, not `Pipeline by Stage`, and the Title box (`#widget-title`) reads the same text;
- zh: a widget retitled in the draft is named by its draft title, as the Title box reads it;
- en: the strip reads the English title;
- the fixture parses against `DashboardSchema`.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the `shownWidgetTitle(...)` call in the strip replaced by `undefined` made the zh served-title case red (1 failed, 3 passed). Restored, blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Page blocks:** this change leaves them alone. Their strip and panel read the same authored block label. The Studio has no served page text (no page counterpart of `servedWidgetTextOf` / `servedReportTextOf`), so a translated page block title shows in its authored language in both places. Making both follow the session language needs a served page pairing, which is a separate change. It is not filed: no live reading was taken here.
- The canvas's inline widget rename strip (`DashboardPreview`) still edits the authored title in the designer locale. That is the editor, not the status line, and this card does not change it.
- No props, exports, catalogue keys or stored metadata change.
